name: Polyplex Corporation Ltd
about: Polyplex Corporation is engaged in manufacturing of BOPP, Blown PP/PE and CPP films used in the flexible packaging industry and in industrial usages like release liners, tapes, labels etc. They have 35 Years Of Experience in Plastic Films. They have 7 Manufacturing Facilities In 5 Countries with Multiple Warehouses & Liaison Offices Worldwide. [1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] The company is an integrated, multinational manufacturer of plastic film substrates, primarily biaxially oriented polyethylene terephthalate (BOPET - thin and thick), biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP), cast polypropylene (CPP), and blown PP/PE films.
pros: Stock is trading at 0.71 times its book value
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 22.4%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 7.58% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.71% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -24.2%

announcements.text: Corporate Action-Board to consider Dividend 7 Nov - Board meeting on November 13, 2026 to consider Q2/H1 results and FY27 interim dividend.

Board Meeting Outcome for Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of The SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations') 6 Nov - Polyplex, promoter group and AGP HoldCo agreed on 6 Nov 2026 to revisit CPA timelines; no control change.

Board Meeting Intimation for Notice Of Board Meeting To Consider Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026 4 Nov - Board meeting on November 13, 2026 to consider Q2 and half-year FY2026-27 unaudited results.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018 12 Oct - Submitted Regulation 74(5) dematerialization compliance certificate for quarter ended September 30, 2026.

Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (Listing Obligations And Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 7 Oct - PTL approved 12,000 MT/year BOPP/BOPE capacity addition in Thailand with INR 147 crore investment by Q4 FY2027-28.
